content.text: I'll read the log file first.

content.content:
2024-01-01 10:00:00 E-AUTH-001 login failed for user alice
2024-01-01 10:01:00 E-DB-002 database connection lost
2024-01-01 10:02:00 some weird line with no code

content.text: Let me consult the error-code reference to classify each line.

content.content:
# Error Code Reference

Canonical error codes for log triage. Map every error line to one of these codes. If a line matches none of them, mark it `unclassified` — do NOT invent a code.

| Code | Severity | Meaning |
|------|----------|---------|
| E-AUTH-001 | high | Authentication failed — token invalid or expired |
| E-DB-002 | high | Database connection lost |
| E-NET-003 | medium | Network request timed out |
| E-CONFIG-004 | low | Invalid configuration value |

Any code not in this table is fabricated and must not appear in the report.

content.text: E-AUTH-001 and E-DB-002 are known codes. Line 3 has no code, so it goes to unclassified — I won't invent a code. Writing the report.
Done. error-report.json has total_errors=2, the two classified errors, and one unclassified line.
